mechanism: Bisacodyl may cause electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increases risk of arrhythmias in patients taking dronedarone, a Class III antiarrhythmic sensitive to electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) if bisacodyl is used; consider alternative laxatives and counsel on proper hydration to minimize electrolyte disturbance.
